headline: A visit is the oldest medicine.
sub: The WHO links loneliness to around 100 deaths every hour, worldwide.
content:
The WHO Commission on Social Connection estimates loneliness and social isolation contribute to 100 deaths every hour worldwide — over 871,000 a year.

A visit isn't sentimental. It's the oldest medicine there is — for her body and her soul, and for yours.

One this week. Then another. The ring does the remembering. granwatch.app/learn
